{{Quote|Whoa, sweet ... just like my landing spot.|Slam gang founder Roper Slam comments on the quint-berry juice he sips over idle reception chat with undercover Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref>}}
'''Quint-berry juice''' was a very sweet juice made from [[quint-berry fruit]].

On the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[mission to Romin]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sipped the super-saccharine beverage at an extravagant reception for the world's wealthy, hosted by [[Romin]]'s corrupt tyrant-ruler, "Great Leader" [[Roy Teda]]. By awkward chance, Kenobi also met, then shared the same sweet drink with the [[Roper Slam|criminal]] he was meant to be impersonating while on the planet.
